name: omniroute
description: Unified AI gateway plugin for OmniRoute — route requests across 339+ providers, compress tokens, and manage failover with a single endpoint.

interface.longDescription: Use OmniRoute to route AI requests across 339+ providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Configure intelligent routing strategies, compress tokens to save 15–95% of costs, manage provider failover, and integrate via MCP, REST, or A2A. Zero-config with keyless free providers pre-configured.
defaultPrompt: Set up OmniRoute as my local AI gateway and configure routing for my project
Configure OmniRoute token compression to reduce my API costs
Add a new provider to OmniRoute and set up failover routing
